definitions.explanation: Equipment installed in parks and playgrounds for children to play on, such as swings, slides, jungle gyms, and seesaws.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}の{遊具|ゆうぐ}で{子|こ}どもが{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: Children are playing on the playground equipment in the park.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{遊具|ゆうぐ}は{危険|きけん}なので{撤去|てっきょ}された。
examples.english: The old playground equipment was removed because it was dangerous.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{遊具|ゆうぐ}が{設置|せっち}されて、{子|こ}どもたちは{大喜|おおよろこ}びだ。
examples.english: New playground equipment was installed and the children are delighted.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {遊|ゆう} (play) and {具|ぐ} (tool/equipment). Used as a general term for all types of playground structures. Individual pieces of equipment have their own names: ブランコ (swings), {滑|すべ}り{台|だい} (slide), ジャングルジム (jungle gym), シーソー (seesaw).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遊具|ゆうぐ}で{遊|あそ}ぶ (to play on playground equipment)
- {遊具|ゆうぐ}を{設置|せっち}する (to install playground equipment)
- {遊具|ゆうぐ}の{点検|てんけん} (inspection of playground equipment)
- {遊具|ゆうぐ}を{撤去|てっきょ}する (to remove playground equipment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おもちゃ: toy — handheld playthings, not fixed structures
- {遊|あそ}び{道具|どうぐ}: play tools — broader, includes toys and games
